prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a finished desktop portfolio webpage edge to edge, with readable English text and no browser chrome, for Martino Ferrero, a systems engineer working in backend development, AI and medical imaging research. A recruiter or client should be able to understand his profile, discover his projects and contact him. Display the name 'Martino Ferrero', navigation Home, About, Projects, Skills, Contact, and a link 'View projects'. Show the first viewport and the start of the projects below. This concept leads with an editorial typographic introduction and a vertical journey through actual work, with Neurollow and Lookeate as project names; keep descriptions brief and generic rather than guessing details. Integrate the supplied caricature as a small human touch. The page feels like a contemporary research publication: a near-black ground, measured fine rules and spacious type, with restrained blue and violet gradients and a subtle network of fine connections. The fixed navigation is transparent. The page must be usable and continuous, with no modal, dashboard, grids of cards, or excessive icons. Typography and real project names lead the composition.
